unsupported: The company began as a mail-order business selling a single product, the Maine Hunting Shoe, and grew into a national retailer of outdoor gear and apparel.
The company designs and sells a wide range of outdoor products, including totes, slippers, footwear, clothing, and equipment for hunting, fishing, and camping.
It operates primarily through its website and catalog, as well as retail stores, with its flagship campus in Freeport, Maine.
L.L.Bean serves consumer markets, targeting outdoor enthusiasts, families, and gift buyers.
Its customer base spans the United States and includes international online shoppers.
The company emphasizes its lifetime guarantee and customer service as key differentiators, positioning its products as durable and backed by a generous return policy.
